summary: OpenAI's Codex coding agent, driven in a terminal.

auto.$comment: Codex's autonomy is enforced by a SANDBOX, not reviewed by a classifier — same rung as Claude Code's auto, different mechanism. `--ask-for-approval never` is deliberate over `on-request`: this is the rung the automation MCP surface forces callers onto (it refuses bypass outright), and a prompting preset does not escalate an unattended run, it hangs it until the idle reaper fails it.
auto.label: Auto — sandboxed to the workspace, never prompts

reasoningSelection.$comment: Codex's documented model_reasoning_effort config override. Rendered only when the selected level differs from the default, so ordinary launches stay byte-for-byte unchanged.

contextInjection.$comment: codex -c <key=value> overrides a config.toml value, and `developer_instructions` is a declared key of codex's own ConfigToml (verified against the installed binary: --help documents -c, and the key is present in the compiled ConfigToml field set). The value is parsed as TOML, so {{contextToml}} renders the document as a quoted, escaped basic string — a raw multi-line value would be a parse error. Deliberately NOT on the resume argv: codex persists a session's own config, exactly as the reasoning-effort override does here.

installTargets.$comment: restartRequired verified false on 2026-07-29: a skill directory created while `codex` was already running appeared in its $skill picker without a restart.

agentStateSpec.$comment: Codex ships Claude-style lifecycle hooks (same stdin payload contract: hook_event_name / session_id) but configured as TOML, written as a marker-delimited managed block so the rest of the user's config.toml is preserved. It uses PermissionRequest (not Claude's Notification) for awaiting-input, and has no SessionEnd — process exit is owned by the pty exit listener. PreToolUse is register:false and PostToolUse registered for the same spawn-halving reason as claude-code; PostToolUse → thinking is what clears awaiting_input after a PermissionRequest is answered. Agent changelists: Codex's only editing tool is apply_patch, whose PostToolUse payload carries the raw V4A patch text in tool_input.command and an exec-style STRING tool_response ("Exit code: 0…") — no file_path, no line numbers. VERIFIED live against codex-cli 0.153.3 (2026-09-09): the reporter parses the patch, locates each hunk's post-image in the file on disk for its line ranges, and sends ONE FRAME PER FILE, since a single patch can rewrite several.
